  • Method Details

    • getPath

      Path2D getPath()
      Gets the shape path.

      The path is translated in the shape's coordinate system, i.e. freeform.getPath2D().getBounds2D() equals to freeform.getAnchor() (small discrepancies are possible due to rounding errors)

      Returns:
      the path
